name: Hagar
summary: An Egyptian maid of Sarai who bore Abram's son Ishmael. Twice in the wilderness, an angel spoke to her and promised that many people would come from her son.

key_moments.title: Given to Abram
key_moments.description: Sarai, who had no children, gave her Egyptian maid Hagar to Abram as a wife. When Hagar conceived and looked down on Sarai, Sarai treated her harshly, and Hagar ran away.

key_moments.title: Found by the Angel of the LORD
key_moments.description: The angel of the LORD found Hagar by a spring on the way to Shur and told her to go back. He said she would have a son named Ishmael, and she called the LORD the God who sees her.

key_moments.title: Sent Away with Her Son
key_moments.description: Abraham sent Hagar and her son away, and they wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba until the water ran out. God heard the boy, opened Hagar's eyes to see a well, and promised to make him a great nation.
